product_brief: Toolkits allowing vendors to transform products for safety against classical and future quantum computer cyber attacks.
pqc_capability_description: Uses NIST-approved post-quantum cryptography (PQC) technologies combined with patent-protected quantum-safe technology. Designed for vertical solutions including digital identity, email security, remote access, cloud storage, IoT, blockchain, and financial transactions.
target_industries: Blockchain, IoT, Data Storage, Remote Access, Email Security, Cloud Storage, Financial Transactions, Digital Identity
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Mentioned for IoT devices and smart cards on credit cards/smartphones.
